cwe_name: URL Redirection to Untrusted Site ('Open Redirect')

exact_cwe_mechanism.evidence: CWE-601 requires redirection to external sites. The code generates internal file server links, not HTTP redirects to external domains.

connection.evidence: User-controlled URL pathname connects to href generation: req.url → parsedUrl.pathname → cleanUrl() → url variable → combined with filename → href attribute

diff_causality.evidence: The added line removes leading slashes from constructed paths, altering URL semantics but not creating redirect functionality

security_control.control_requirement_evidence: CWE-601 requires controls to prevent redirects to untrusted external sites
existing_controls_checked: cleanUrl removes '..' sequences but doesn't validate external URLs
vpath check ensures URL starts with virtual path
security_control.deficiency_evidence: No redirect validation exists because no redirect functionality is demonstrated

concrete_impact.evidence: No redirect mechanism exists; links point to internal file server resources, not external sites

diff_counterfactual: If the candidate line were reverted, href links would retain leading slashes, potentially creating malformed internal URLs but not affecting redirect behavior.
supporting_evidence: User-controlled URL pathname used in href generation
No validation of path segments in constructed links
contradicting_evidence: Links point to internal file server paths, not external domains
res.write() generates HTML content, not redirect headers
unresolved_facts: Whether double slash removal creates path traversal opportunities
Effectiveness of cleanUrl against other path manipulation techniques
